title: Repair access and leave a safe handover
goal: Combine narrow membership, inherited ownership, modes and cleanup into an evidenced access repair.
challenge: Use the supplied faulty ll-u8 fixture. Allow ll-u8 to read and append the handover and create a team-owned new note; retain ll-u8keep membership, deny nobody, keep notes non-executable and other=0. Record original fault, smallest repair and identity-based evidence; clean up only this fixture.

steps.command: ! getent passwd ll-u8 && ! getent group ll-u8 && test ! -e /home/ll-u8 && sudo useradd -m -U -s /bin/bash ll-u8
steps.explanation: Fail closed if this disposable name or home exists. -m creates a home from /etc/skel; -U creates a primary group; no password is set.
steps.expected: Fresh account ll-u8, same-named primary group, home and Bash shell. A nonzero status/collision means stop setup.

steps.command: ! getent group ll-u8keep && ! getent group ll-u8team && test ! -e /srv/ll-u8 && sudo groupadd ll-u8keep && sudo groupadd ll-u8team && sudo usermod -aG ll-u8keep ll-u8 && sudo install -d -o root -g root -m 0700 /srv/ll-u8
steps.explanation: Supply an independent Challenge fault; setup is not the solution. Account has unrelated keep membership.
steps.expected: Root-only directory and no team membership for ll-u8.

steps.command: printf 'handover\n' | sudo tee /srv/ll-u8/note.txt; sudo chmod 0600 /srv/ll-u8/note.txt; sudo runuser -u ll-u8 -- cat /srv/ll-u8/note.txt
steps.explanation: Capture the failure before editing. For Challenge, an initial mistake is not a completion requirement.
steps.expected: Permission denied; original root:root 700 directory / 600 file.

steps.command: sudo usermod -aG ll-u8team ll-u8; sudo chgrp ll-u8team /srv/ll-u8 /srv/ll-u8/note.txt; sudo chmod 2770 /srv/ll-u8; sudo chmod 0660 /srv/ll-u8/note.txt
steps.explanation: Repair membership, directory traversal/create, inherited group and existing file write separately. No world permission or owner change required.

steps.command: sudo runuser -u ll-u8 -- bash -c 'umask 0007; cat /srv/ll-u8/note.txt; printf "checked\n" >> /srv/ll-u8/note.txt; printf "new\n" > /srv/ll-u8/new.txt'
steps.explanation: A fresh process uses new groups. Read, append and new-file creation must all work.
steps.expected: handover read; checked append; team-owned non-executable new note.

steps.command: id ll-u8; sudo stat -c '%U:%G %a' /srv/ll-u8 /srv/ll-u8/note.txt /srv/ll-u8/new.txt; sudo runuser -u nobody -- cat /srv/ll-u8/note.txt
steps.explanation: Inspect bits and test outsider access separately; do not declare success because root can read.
steps.expected: keep and team remain; correct group/modes; nobody denied.

steps.command: printf '%s\n' 'FAULT: root-only paths and missing membership' 'REPAIR: append membership, group ownership, bounded modes' 'EVIDENCE: read, append, inherited new file, outsider denial' 'LIMIT: self-review, no authentication test' 'CLEANUP: exact ll-u8 fixtures only' > "$HOME/ll-u8-handover.txt"
steps.explanation: Retain a small evidence-based report before cleanup. Replace example evidence with your own observed results.
steps.expected: Handover is learner-owned outside the disposable account home.

hints: A mode-only repair does not give the user missing team membership.
Use -aG so keep is preserved; repair parent traversal before diagnosing the child.
Verify read, append, inherited new-file group and outsider denial as separate claims.
review: Retain original/final evidence and a short handover with actual identity-based observations; equivalent narrow repairs are acceptable.
After cleanup, account/groups and exact /srv/ll-u8 fixtures absent; learner and its sudo rights remain unchanged.
coverage: LPIC-1 107.1/104.5 reinforcement and integration. Partial coverage; original material, self-review only. No automatic assessment or full LPIC preparation.
